clauses.reason: EO:13350 expressly revokes EO:12734 and ends the supporting emergency. Section 10 controls: July 30, 2004 at 12:01 a.m. EDT. The original has no sunset or command tied to an independently identified earlier date. Invocation of construction authority in accordance with its terms does not make completion of an unspecified individual project an end of the general presidential authorization.
clauses.mechanism: express revocation and termination of supporting national emergency

savings.reason: EO:13350 section 1 preserves actions taken, pending proceedings, prior-act proceedings, matured rights/duties, and penalties. This preserves accrued project or contractual effects where applicable, not fresh construction authority under the revoked order. No independent continuing command appears in EO:12734.

research_rationale: The entire original invokes 10 U.S.C. 2808 emergency construction authority for the Secretary of Defense and, at that Secretary's discretion, military department secretaries. Its immediate effectiveness and publication requirements supply no own-terms sunset. The bounded later-event search identifies EO:13350 as the ending instrument; its preamble expressly revokes EO:12734 while section 10 sets July 30, 2004 at 12:01 a.m. EDT, rather than July 29 signing. Section 1 preserves accrued actions and liabilities. The two missing target-location labels for EO:12722 and EO:12724 do not establish an earlier ending: both instruments predate this November 1990 authorization, and the held original itself identifies its supporting emergency. No indicated earlier actor or clause-specific end remains unresolved. Project-specific accrued effects are distinguished from the general authorization. Full-freeze audit: The frozen onefile additionally holds complete EO:12722 and EO:12724 contexts. EO:12722 declares the Iraqi emergency; EO:12724 section 6 revokes EO:12722 only to the extent inconsistent and carries administrative action forward. Neither instrument terminates the Iraqi emergency or addresses the subsequent November 14, 1990 construction-authority invocation. Their missing target-provision labels therefore are not missing later endings. No sunset appears in the original. Completion of an individual project does not exhaust the general invocation; the indicated legal ending remains express revocation and emergency termination at 12:01 a.m. EDT July 30, 2004. Section 1 saves prior actions and accrued rights/duties; it does not retain fresh construction authority.
